name: Meteora Dynamic Bonding Curve
description: Meteora's Dynamic Bonding Curve is a permissionless token launch protocol that allows platforms to create customizable bonding curve pools for new tokens, enabling immediate trading, flexible fee structures, and automated migration to AMMs

methodology.Revenue: Protocol fees collected by Meteora DBC protocol.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Protocol fees collected by Meteora DBC protocol, minus the MET buybacks funded from Meteora protocol revenue.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: MET token buybacks funded from Meteora protocol revenue across all Meteora products.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The portion of the trading fees paid to LPs and referrals.
